metadata.description: Shared parameters for prod environment alert deployments. These parameters are referenced across multiple alert rule templates to ensure consistency.
Resource ID of the Application Insights instance for prod environment alert rules
Resource ID of the Log Analytics Workspace for prod environment KQL-based alert rules
Default email address for prod environment alert notifications
Email address for Zone 1 (Personal Productivity) alert notifications in prod environment
Email address for Zone 2 (Team Collaboration) alert notifications in prod environment
Email address for Zone 3 (Enterprise Managed) alert notifications in prod environment
Resource ID of the Logic App that handles Teams notifications for prod environment
HTTPS callback URL for the Logic App trigger (obtained from Logic App deployment outputs). Replace with actual URL after Logic App deployment.
Resource ID of the Zone 1 (Personal Productivity) Action Group for prod environment
Resource ID of the Zone 2 (Team Collaboration) Action Group for prod environment
Resource ID of the Zone 3 (Enterprise Managed) Action Group for prod environment
